test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Agriculture is the backbone of our economy.

P: Farmers work hard despite unpredictable weather.

Q: They grow crops that feed the nation.

R: Yet, they face several challenges.

S: Modern technology can support better yield.

6. Ensuring farmer welfare is national duty.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** (i.e. **PQRS**).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Start with the general statement: **“Agriculture is the backbone of our economy.”**
 
• Follow with **P**: *Farmers work hard despite unpredictable weather* — this introduces farmers’ effort (logical first detail).
 
• Then **Q**: *They grow crops that feed the nation* — explains what farmers do and why their work matters.
 
• Next **R**: *Yet, they face several challenges* — contrast that follows naturally after stating their contribution.
 
• Finally **S**: *Modern technology can support better yield* — offers a solution/way forward before the concluding duty sentence.

 

**Coherent paragraph after arrangement (1 → P → Q → R → S → 6):**

Agriculture is the backbone of our economy. Farmers work hard despite unpredictable weather. They grow crops that feed the nation. Yet, they face several challenges. Modern technology can support better yield. Ensuring farmer welfare is national duty.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (PRQS):** P→R places the contrast (challenges) immediately after mentioning effort, but it skips explaining the farmers' contribution (Q) before the contrast — less smooth flow.
 
• **Option 3 (QPRS):** Starting with Q (*They grow crops…*) before P (*Farmers work hard…*) makes the order less natural — we usually mention who does the work (P) then what they do (Q).
 
• **Option 4 (QRSP):** Q→R puts the contribution then challenges but separates the statement about farmers working hard (P) and places the suggested solution (S) awkwardly; overall less logical.
